label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to `http://localhost:3000` whenever the `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable isn't set (src/notifications/templates.ts:8), and `passwordResetEmail` builds the reset link from that BASE_URL. If `PUBLIC_URL` isn't configured in the production environment (or was dropped in last week's release), reset emails, weekly rollup links, and scheduled export links will all point to localhost. The fix should ensure `PUBLIC_URL` is properly set in the deployment config, and/or this code should fail loudly instead of silently falling back to localhost in non-dev environments.
